title: IPO Skills：香港上市项目工作笔记
content: 本文内容均为本人实务工作经验总结，仅供参考。 My Skills Workstream Scope Due diligence (DD) TPDD, DSM DD, Expert DD, Bringdown DD and FDD DD questionnaires (DDQ) Drafting and modifying TPDDQ, FDDQ, Cornerstone Investor DDQ, Background Search DDQ and confirmation Verification All sections of the prospectus Circle-up Reviewing the scope of accounting items and audit marking Precedents search Searching precedents Offering statistics Updating offering statistics in the prospectus Comment and response letters Consolidating comment letters and response letters Internal checklist Chapter 3 of the Guide for New Listing Applicants Weekly meetings Preparing weekly meeting material Due Diligence InterviewsPreparation Arrive 15 minutes in advance. Do not be late. Familiarise yourself with the questionnaire beforehand. Do not read it verbatim; adjust flexibly. Learn about the company’s business in advance. Dress appropriately. Communication Mind your tone. Raise sensitive questions tactfully to avoid offending interviewees. For identity document requirements, state the needs in advance. Explain that confidentiality will be maintained and key information redacted for protection. For PI interviews of 18A companies, pay special attention to interview pacing and maintain a humble attitude. Coordination Coordinate closely with the PRC lawyer. Do not miss questions, and avoid speaking too quickly. Coordinate closely with the sponsors. After finishing the questions, check whether the sponsor has any follow-up questions. Drafting and Modifying DDQFDDQFDDQ preparation requires accounting knowledge and familiarity with each account’s definition and key considerations. In routine inquiries on fluctuations, focus on accounts with large variances and market-inconsistent movements, such as higher sales volume but lower profitability. Pay special attention to accounts materially affecting the company’s profitability and liquidity. Stub TPDDQTPDDQ questions should be designed in accordance with the regulatory requirements under the Guide. Gain a prior understanding of the company’s business. For example, for 18A companies, check whether their products fall within government bulk procurement and identify regulatory requirements beyond routine matters such as clinical filings. Questionnaire Coverage TPDDQ Respondent information, transaction details, product quality, scope of cooperation, contractual arrangements, payment terms, regulatory policies, disputes, independence and business outlook Stub TPDDQ Key information including transaction details, payment terms, dispute resolution and independence; confirm that there are no changes in the other sections Background Search DDQ Review background investigation reports. Analyse material events affecting the company’s operations. Formulate questions. Design the questionnaire according to the nature of the events. Consolidate questions. Prevent an unduly lengthy questionnaire from impeding respondents. VerificationMargin Notes and V Request ListsStep 0 — Margin notes: Mark margin notes for every sentence. Step 1 — V request list: The objective is to ensure that every statement is supported by documents. Distinguish factual statements from value-based statements. Statement type Examples Supporting approach Factual statements Actual corporate events, such as leased properties and intellectual property rights Require documentary support Value-based statements Assessments such as “leading technology” and “end-to-end support” Involve personal judgement and require consideration of the supporting basis There are several approaches to value-based statements: Confirmation by industry experts. Inference based on documentary support. Acceptance of statements consistent with common sense. Flagging extreme wording for revision by the company and its lawyer. For example, HKEX prohibits excessive use of superlative language describing the company’s business in the prospectus. Section-specific ConsiderationsDifferent sections carry distinct caveats and challenges. Section Focus BIZ Understand the company’s business. Pay special attention to adjectives, including superlatives, and frequency terms. Every data point must be supported by documents, preferably external test reports or internal test reports together with acceptance forms. FI Understand the marking scope and accounting items. History Pay particular attention to verifying dates and figures. DSM Pay particular attention to communication with the company’s directors and senior management. RF / IO Cross-check against legal opinions and industry reports. Verification Comments (V Cmts)Verification comments cover: Factual errors. Typos and grammatical errors. Unverifiable value-based statements. Supporting references can be attached where comments are few. Copies can be sent to other intermediaries as applicable: Revision or inconsistency Relevant intermediary Revisions to financial data Auditors Revisions to the IO chapter Industry consultants Inconsistencies between Chinese legal opinions and the prospectus or company workpapers PRC lawyer Verification Documents (V Docs) Naming convention: Number + summary of document content. For oversized documents, highlight the information being verified. Verification Notes (V Notes) Record the document title. Annotate key document content if time permits. Annotate calculation formulas for figures derived from computation outside the circle-up scope. Circle-upAccounting items may be marked, while non-accounting items may not be marked. Item Marking scope BIZ data, such as production volume and average selling price Generally not marked Overly segmented revenue breakdowns Generally not marked Revenue classified by end customers or at the company’s discretion Generally not marked Approximate figures Not marked; marking is allowed if stated as precise numbers Social security shortfall Generally not marked; arguable Post-period financial data Generally not marked; some audit teams may mark C for the proportion of post-period settlements Credit balance Generally not marked Cash operating costs Generally not marked Listing expenses Total listing expenses can be marked, while breakdown items may not Familiarity with the circle-up scope enables you to flag omissions in audit marking and discuss them with the audit team. Updating Offering StatisticsRefresh the data in the prospectus based on the offering statistics provided by the sponsor. Understand the offering figures and conduct the updates carefully, without omissions. Consolidating Comment and Response Letters Task Key point Cover letter Update information based on the template, such as the sponsor list and submitted documents. Comment letter Preserve formatting when copying. Work allocation Allocate tasks based on familiarity with the prospectus. Internal ChecklistFor Chapter 3 of the Guide for New Listing Applicants, conduct a page check based on your understanding of the prospectus, and check whether the company’s lawyer has omitted any matters.

title: 初次访问：本站内容导览
content: 欢迎第一次来到这里的朋友。你可以先阅读安明艳的简历，了解更完整的个人经历；下面按简历页面的栏目，介绍本站目前整理的内容。 个人信息这里记录安明艳的基本信息和个人背景，帮助访问者快速了解作者。 教育经历这里整理在中国政法大学和西南政法大学的学习经历，包括专业方向、就读时间、绩点、排名和主要课程。 荣誉证书与技能这里记录法律职业资格、基金从业资格、初级会计职业证书、英语能力，以及在校期间获得的奖学金等信息。 实习经历这里介绍在律师事务所和人民法院的实践经历，涵盖港股 IPO、金融证券、争议解决、法律检索、尽职调查、法律文书起草和诉讼项目等内容。 科研经历这里整理参与的校级科研项目，主题包括数字经济与地方经济增长、区块链视阈下的中小股东权益保护，记录数据搜集、模型分析、实地调研、论文报告和学术答辩等工作。 在校经历这里记录法律援助、研究生会、律师训练营、法律诊所、志愿者项目、辩论队和本科招生服务队等经历，展示法律实践、组织协调、表达沟通和项目执行方面的积累。 本站会持续整理法律学习、研究和工作经验，也欢迎从具体文章或上方简历页面开始阅读。
